summary.short_summary: Baitshoppe Shop has transitioned from a production service provider to a company with 90% direct-to-brand revenue, driven by a need for better margins and control. Evan Starkman highlighted their unique experiential production capabilities that distinguish them from competitors. The firm operates with approximately 20 full-time staff and relies on inbound business development. For 2024, it anticipates a $30 million revenue run rate. The company also owns a separate fabrication LLC, which handles diverse prototyping and production tasks but operates independently due to lower margins. The meeting underscored the division between creative production and event logistics, with Baitshoppe Shop excelling in comprehensive event execution. Jeff Kaplan outlined a five-year acquisition strategy to build an integrated experiential group, emphasizing a cultural fit in potential partnerships while preserving operational independence.
